inventory.memory_optional_dependency: numpy>=1.24 (synthetic vectors, not a real embedding model)

findings.evidence: nova_core_v1.yml recursively discovers tests/. Accepted HEAD selection distinguishes 43 current Knowledge files and 2 historical certification artifacts.
findings.proposed: Review an explicit auditable active-test selection; keep historical scorers as immutable archival code, not a CI certification job. Do not merely add --ignore flags to obtain green.

cases.dependency: verify_current_post_cert_identity() reads the external 241-pin proof directly in two checks and through measure() in the native frozen V6 quality regression

findings.proposed: Separate archive verification from ordinary product regression at function granularity; preserve and account for every active contract. Do not change frozen tests, copy local state into fake paths, add skips, or assert that a model/historical campaign must run on GitHub.

findings.evidence: No setup-node/npm ci job. Python Desktop contract wrapper can take its preexisting devdeps-unavailable skip, and does not run the two new Knowledge JS contract suites.

proposed.contracts: node --experimental-transform-types --test tests/application_client.test.cjs tests/approval_host.test.cjs tests/security_audit.test.cjs tests/memory_control.test.cjs tests/memory_maintenance.test.cjs tests/knowledge_control.test.cjs tests/knowledge_k7.test.cjs
proposed.note: Ordinary current contracts, not Electron GUI/Ollama E2E; do not use packaging/publish scripts.

findings.evidence: Editable Python install now includes pinned pypdf. MEMORY jobs install memory-semantic for synthetic NumPy coverage. Core does not install that optional extra, but Memory jobs provide it; Knowledge vectors are dependency-free doubles. No real local backend installation is proposed.

Direct pytest exits propagate; run_regression raises SystemExit(subprocess returncode). No continue-on-error or || true. always() steps report scope, they do not override prior test failure. fail-fast=false only retains matrix diagnostics.
No explicit timeout/caches/artifact uploads; Memory writes run.json/run.log/tests.xml outside checkout and step summaries. Not a YAML syntax defect.
findings.proposed: If CI scope is approved, preserve exit codes while adding bounded timeouts and always-upload only fresh synthetic logs/JUnit. Caches must be keyed by pyproject/desktop package-lock; never cache operational stores or certification evidence.

findings.note: Explicit Electron/local Ollama and external-archive integrity require special infrastructure. Existing optional environment guards unchanged. No campaign runner, AUTHORIZED file or quality ledger is invoked by the proposed general CI.
